text_block_list.text:
On this day, we visited an inn to take photos
for a magazine feature on Racing Gear.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hell yeah!
This spot looks like it'll make for a real stylish photo!"

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Right! There are plenty of spots around here that seem like a great match for Inari-san's racing silks!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Like expressing Inari-san's bursting wild side on top of a rock by a mountain stream!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text: Or maybe it'd be great to take a photo in an open area, with the wind catching your racing silks!

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
"Is there anything specific
you would like, Inari-san?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Indoors.
How about a traditional Japanese room with tatami mats?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
Huh, indoors?
It certainly seems like it would fit a Japanese-style room, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, whether it's good or bad, why don't we shoot a test reel and find out?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: —How's that, eh?

text_block_list.name: Cameraman
text_block_list.text:
I-It's incredible!!
Your expression is so vivid, yet full of dignified strength!
Let's do the actual shoot here too!
I was shown the photos, and Inari One's lively spirit practically leaped off the prints.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, what's with that!
It tickles getting praised so straightforwardly!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Well, Japanese-style rooms and tatami mats are practically old friends of mine. Really gets me fired up.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, that's right. We've been doing this together all along.
Ever since we were little brats, the wholeeee time."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: You see, the boss used to gather all us little Umamusume and teach us how to run at his place.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
""And that's why keeping pace is...
Hey, Inari! You're sleeping on the tatami again!""

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I just loved the smell of that rush matting, y'know?
I'd often fall asleep on it and get scolded—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, didn't I tell you you don't have to sit seiza
until you get used to it?"

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"S-Shut yer trap! Even an Edokko's
gotta know how to endure!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Admiring the boss and the crew's spirit,
I tried doing reckless things—

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey, Inari, what are you gonna do in the future?"

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text: "Well of course, it's already decided! I'm gonna make a name for myself so everyone knows 'Inari is in Edo'!"

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Oho~! Big words!
Well, you gotta beat me first, y'know~?"

text_block_list.name: Young Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Whaddya say?! That was by a nose!
That's well within margin of error, I say!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
“Talking about our dreams, fighting,
laughing, crying... it was just so much fun.”

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So, y'know... if we're taking a picture, I wanted to include these tatami mats I've known for so long.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: If we do that, I'm sure the folks back home will notice once they see these tatami mats.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "That Inari, talkin' big dreams like always!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "Both now and in the past, to die on a tatami mat..." or something like that!
Hearing that gets me fired up too. I want to make sure the real photoshoot yields even better pictures. In that case—
choice_data_list: Let's make this a chic shoot!
Since we're here, wanna take the photo sitting in seiza?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me!
I'll show ya the most stylish Inari-sama you've ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, I can already picture the look
of pure joy on the bosses' faces!
With that spirit in mind, they tackled the photoshoot and wrapped up a stylish, successful session.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah! Fine by me!
One hour, two hours, bring on whatever you got!"
choice_data_list: I thought you were bad at sitting seiza...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hah! The only thing that hasn't changed is my dream. Everything else has been growing steadily!
They apologized for underestimating Inari One, and after that, the photoshoot proceeded just as she had wished.
